title: Reports
content: The Reports page lets you generate and export summaries across your IVF operations — monthly KPI snapshots, critical alert history, and detailed refill logs — all in one place.

title: Open Reports
content: Click here to open the Reports page.

title: Report Filters
content: Use these filters to narrow your report by branch, date range, and report type. Select the parameters that matter for your audit or review, then generate the report.

title: Monthly Summary Report
content: The Monthly Summary Report gives you a KPI-level breakdown for a selected month — showing how many alerts were sent and how many deviations were detected per parameter.

title: Month Filter
content: Pick any month to load its summary. The table updates instantly — no need to click a submit button.

title: Monthly Summary — Results
content: The table shows each KPI config alongside the total alerts sent and deviations found for the selected month. Use this to identify which parameters triggered the most incidents.

title: Critical Alert Report
content: The Critical Alert Report lists every alert triggered across your tanks within a date range. Filter by status, severity, or specific tank codes to drill into incidents that need attention.

title: Date From
content: Set the start of your date range. Only alerts that occurred on or after this date will appear in the results.

title: Date To
content: Set the end of your date range. Combine with Date From to focus on a specific incident window.

title: Status Filter
content: Filter alerts by their current status — Active alerts are still open, Acknowledged means a team member has reviewed them.

title: Severity Filter
content: Narrow results to High, Medium, or Low severity alerts. High severity alerts typically require immediate action.

title: Tank Codes Filter
content: Select one or more specific tanks to see only alerts from those containers. Useful for investigating a single tank's incident history.

title: Critical Alerts — Results
content: Each row shows when the alert occurred, its severity and status, the tank it came from, and the alert message. Rows are sorted newest first.

title: Refill Logs Report
content: The Refill Logs Report tracks every LN2 refill across sites — who performed it, when, which tank, and whether the LN2 was ordered and received on time.

title: Date From
content: Filter refill logs starting from this date. Helps you scope the report to a specific operational period.

title: Date To
content: Set the upper bound for the refill date range to keep results focused on the period you care about.

title: Status Filter
content: Filter by refill status — Not started, In progress, or Done — to track which refills are still pending or have been completed.

title: Tank Codes Filter
content: Select specific tanks to view only their refill history. Useful for auditing a single container's maintenance record.

title: Refill Logs — Results
content: Each row captures a complete refill event — the tank, branch, who refilled it, the refill date and time, the reservoir used, and LN2 order and receipt dates.

title: Activity Logs
content: Activity Logs give admins and managers a full audit trail — every user action, system event, and automated trigger is recorded here.

title: Date From
content: Restrict the audit trail to events that happened on or after this date.

title: Date To
content: Set the end of the window you want to audit. Together with Date From, this scopes the log to a precise time period.

title: Actions Filter
content: Pick one or more specific action types — such as user logins, alert acknowledgements, or refill detections — to filter the log down to exactly the events you need.

title: Outcome Filter
content: Filter by outcome — success, failure, or partial — to quickly surface failed operations or partially completed actions that may need follow-up.

title: Actor Type Filter
content: Distinguish between actions taken by a human user versus automated system processes, scheduled jobs, or external webhooks.

title: Search
content: Type a keyword and press Enter to search across actions, actor names, targets, and outcomes. Useful for tracking a specific user's activity or finding a particular event.

title: Activity Logs — Results
content: Each row shows the action performed, who did it, what it affected, the outcome, and a metadata summary with the key details of that event.

title: Download Your Report
content: Once you've applied your filters and reviewed the data on screen, click Download CSV to export the full result set for offline analysis or compliance records.
